description: Finds the sites of a CALLER-SUPPLIED enzyme definition — one that is not in the 754-enzyme REBASE table, or one of the 334 REBASE enzymes whose cut position REBASE leaves undefined and which therefore cannot be resolved by name. Give the recognition sequence (IUPAC codes allowed, need not be palindromic) and the two cut offsets, counted from the first base of the site: cut_position_forward is the number of site bases 5' of the top-strand cut and cut_position_reverse the same for the bottom-strand cut, so EcoRI G^AATTC / GAATT^C is (1, 5) and the Type IIS BsaI GGTCTCN^NNNN is (7, 11). Offsets outside the site are allowed and are how a distal (Type IIS/IIB) cutter is expressed; a negative offset cuts upstream of the site. second_cut_forward/second_cut_reverse add the second cut pair of a two-sided (Type IIB) cutter such as BaeI (23, 18) and must leave the same stagger as the first pair. Coordinates, the two records per palindromic site, the linear cut-feasibility rule and the circular wrap are exactly as in find_restriction_sites. Call when the enzyme is not in the table — use find_restriction_sites for any named one.

sequence.description: DNA sequence to scan. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence.

recognition_sequence.description: Recognition sequence of the custom enzyme: 1 or more of the 15 IUPAC nucleotide codes; need not be palindromic.

cut_position_forward.description: Top-strand cut offset: the number of recognition-sequence bases 5' of the cut. May be negative or exceed the site length for a distal cutter.

cut_position_reverse.description: Bottom-strand cut offset in the same frame. For a palindromic enzyme cut_position_forward + cut_position_reverse equals the site length.

name.description: Name reported on each site record; defaults to "CustomEnzyme".

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

second_cut_forward.description: Optional second top-strand cut offset of a two-sided (Type IIB) cutter; pass both second offsets or neither.

second_cut_reverse.description: Optional second bottom-strand cut offset; must leave the same stagger as the first pair.

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam", "dcm", "dam+dcm" or "emboss". A recognition window containing a methylated base is NOT a site.

sites.description: Site records in the same shape as find_restriction_sites.

errors.message: Pass both second_cut_forward and second_cut_reverse, or neither.
